t: Focal Maritime Services completes sand delivery to Buġibba and St. George’s Bay beaches
html:
Two of the most popular beach locations in Malta, the Buġibba perched beach and St. George’s Bay are now ready for Summer’s beachgoers following a major sand delivery carried out by Focal Maritime Services.

While locals and tourists alike will enjoy the comfort of a sandy beach sparing little thought to the process behind it, this involved an extensive logistical operation where over 5,000 metric tonnes of sand were imported from Akaba, Jordan, and delivered to Malta.

This followed the award of a tender by Malta Tourism Authority to Focal Maritime Services which included the loading of the sand from Aqaba, Jordan, the chartering of a suitable vessel for the sea freight from Jordan to Malta, the discharge at the port of Valletta and the transport by road to the two seaside villages respectively.

Jesmond Abela, Deputy GM at Focal Maritime Services, said, “We’re thrilled to contribute to the readiness of Bugibba and St. George’s beaches for a fantastic summer season. Our team’s efficiency and logistical capabilities ensured the sand was delivered smoothly and on schedule.”

These two popular beach locations are favourites for both locals and tourists alike, offering prime spots for relaxation and enjoyment. With the new sand in place, visitors can look forward to pristine conditions as they soak up the sun and enjoy the beautiful Maltese coastline.
